definitions.gloss: lucky direction sushi roll (eaten on Setsubun)
definitions.explanation: A thick, uncut sushi roll eaten whole on Setsubun (February 3rd) while facing the year's auspicious direction and making a silent wish, believed to bring good fortune.

examples.japanese: {恵方巻|えほうまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{恵方巻|えほうまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an ehoumaki roll on Setsubun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恵方|えほう}→恵方：12858_ehou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南南東|なんなんとう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そちら→そちら：00990_sochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧{恵方巻|えほうまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: This year's lucky direction is south-southeast, so I faced that way to eat my ehoumaki roll.

notes:
A thick sushi roll eaten on ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧ (February 3rd) as part of a tradition believed to bring good luck. The roll is eaten whole, without cutting, while facing the year's lucky direction (⟦{恵方|えほう}→恵方：12858_ehou⟧) and making a wish in silence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恵方巻|えほうまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸|まる}かぶり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eat the roll in one go without cutting
- ⟦{恵方|えほう}→恵方：12858_ehou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat facing the lucky direction
- ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恵方巻|えほうまき}: Setsubun ehoumaki

CULTURAL NOTE:
Originally a Kansai regional custom, the tradition spread nationwide from the late 1990s largely through convenience store marketing campaigns. It is now a major seasonal food event, with stores competing to offer elaborate varieties. The roll traditionally contains seven ingredients, corresponding to the ⟦{七福神|しちふくじん}→七福神：08819_shichifukujin⟧ (Seven Lucky Gods). Some people find the commercialization excessive, and the practice of discarding unsold rolls has drawn criticism for food waste.
